###

segments.text: Did you know disorder can kill quantum sensor accuracy?
Quantum sensors rely on super precise entangled states. But real systems are messy and noisy.
We built a method to model spin behavior on complex, random networks.
It splits spins into collective rotations and tiny wave vibrations.
This predicts when quantum advantage survives or fails in disordered setups.
Here’s the wild part: a single number, the spectral dimension, controls the scaling!
If it’s above 3, squeezing is robust and powerful. Below 2? Forget it.
Follow for more mind-blowing physics hits like this!
